name: Aoyagi Madoka
source:
A Kunahama manager that continues taking care of her wild club members. Shion's little sister. A classmate of [url=https://vndb.org/c22771]Masaya[/url] and his friends and the manager of the FC club. She believes the time for her to shine will come someday.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
